claim.claim-text: 1. A method of quantifying an active pharmaceutical ingredient delivered to a food product, the method comprising the steps of:
2. The method of claim 1, wherein each of the microdroplets has a respective volume in a range from approximately 2 nanoliters to approximately 10 microliters.
3. The method of claim 2, wherein the volume is in a range from approximately 25 nanoliters to approximately 2 microliters.
4. The method of claim 3, wherein the volume is in a range from approximately 25 nanoliters to approximately 1 microliter.

5. The method of any one of claims 1 to 4, further comprising the step of comparing the cross-sectional dimensions to each other to ensure consistency of the volume of the microdroplets delivered to the food product.
6. The method of any one of claims 2 to 5, further comprising the step of integrating the cross-sectional dimensions into a feedback loop associated with operation of the dosing system.
7. The method of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the microdroplets have an elongate shape when they leave the dosing head.
8. The method of claim 7, wherein the measuring step is performed after the microdroplets have transformed from the elongate shape into a shape that is more spherical than the elongate shape.
9. The method of claim 8, wherein the measuring step is performed after the microdroplets have transformed into an approximate spherical shape.
10. The method of any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein calculating step comprises the step of calculating an approximation of the volume of each of the microdroplets.

11. The method of claim 10, further comprising the step of comparing the approximations of the volumes of the microdroplets to each other to ensure consistency of the volume of the microdroplets delivered to the food product.
12. A dosing system for quantifying an active pharmaceutical ingredient delivered to a food product, the dosing system comprising:
13. The dosing system of claim 12, wherein each of the microdroplets has a respective volume in a range from approximately 2 nanoliters to approximately 10 microliters.
14. The dosing system of claim 13, wherein the volume is in a range from approximately 25 nanoliters to approximately 2 microliters.
15. The dosing system of claim 14, wherein the volume is in a range from approximately 25 nanoliters to approximately 1 microliter.

16. The dosing system of any one of claims 12 to 15, configured to compare the cross-sectional dimensions to each other to ensure consistency of the volume of the microdroplets delivered to the food product.
17. The dosing system of any one of claims 12 to 16, configured to integrate the measured cross-sectional dimensions into a feedback loop associated with operation of the dosing system.
18. The dosing system of any one of claims 12 to 17, wherein the microdroplets have an elongate shape when they leave the dosing head.

19. The dosing system of claim 18, wherein the camera is positioned to measure the cross-sectional dimension of each of the microdroplets after the microdroplets have transformed from the elongate shape into a shape that is more spherical than the elongate shape.

20. The dosing system of claim 19, wherein the camera is positioned to measure the cross-sectional dimension of each of the microdroplets after the microdroplets have transformed into an approximate spherical shape.
21. The dosing system of any one of claims 12 to 20, configured to calculate an approximation of the volume of each of the microdroplets.

22. The dosing system of claim 21, configured to compare the approximations of the volumes of the microdroplets to each other to ensure consistency of the volume of microdroplets delivered to the food product.
